title: 780. Rabbits in Forest

examples.explanation: A pair plus a trio gives five rabbits.
Three speakers fit inside one group of eleven.
Two lone rabbits plus two pairs (one with a silent partner) total six.

hints: Rabbits giving the same answer a can share groups of size a+1; count how many speakers gave each answer.
For each distinct answer, the number of groups needed is the ceiling of count/(a+1).
Multiply groups by group size and sum across all distinct answers.
